prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a read-only `stats` command that reports total, pending, completed, and completion percentage rounded to one decimal using invariant formatting. Also report counts created on each UTC calendar date, ordered ascending; empty storage must produce zeros and an empty date list. Support `--json` with stable property names and types, and ensure the command never rewrites storage. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/stats.txt` and integrate it so non-JSON statistics display the banner before the dashboard, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `STATS`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Text stats renders the exact registered banner once before its expected dashboard.
Empty stats uses zeros and an empty date list.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit b69fb95af15ff6cf350d0d53e6bb4068ce99b1d9.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$statsDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats-tasks.json'
$emptyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty-tasks.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/stats.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $bannerBytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerFile)
    $bannerText = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $bannerLines = $bannerText.Substring(0, $bannerText.Length - 1).Split("`n")
    Assert-True (
        $bannerLines.Count -eq 12 -and
        @($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=-]{20,48}$' }).Count -eq 0 -and
        $bannerText.Contains('STATS') -and
        $bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and
        $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10 -and
        -not $bannerBytes.Contains([byte]13) -and
        @($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0
    ) 'stats banner should satisfy all asset constraints'

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $emptyStats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $emptyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($emptyStats.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats should succeed with missing storage'
    $emptyStatistics = $emptyStats.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $emptyStatistics.total -eq 0 -and
        $emptyStatistics.pending -eq 0 -and
        $emptyStatistics.completed -eq 0 -and
        $emptyStatistics.completionPercentage -eq 0.0 -and
        @($emptyStatistics.createdByDate).Count -eq 0
    ) 'empty stats JSON should contain zeros and an empty date list'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $emptyDataFile)) 'stats should not create missing storage'

    @'
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "title": "Pending",
    "description": "",
    "status": "pending",
    "createdAt": "2025-01-03T00:30:00+02:00"
  },
  {
    "id": 2,
    "title": "Completed one",
    "description": "",
    "status": "completed",
    "createdAt": "2025-01-03T01:30:00+00:00"
  },
  {
    "id": 3,
    "title": "Completed two",
    "description": "",
    "status": "completed",
    "createdAt": "2025-01-02T23:30:00-02:00"
  }
]
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $statsDataFile -NoNewline
    $contentBeforeStats = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statsDataFile -Raw
    $writeTimeBeforeStats = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $statsDataFile).LastWriteTimeUtc

    $jsonStats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($jsonStats.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats JSON should succeed'
    $statistics = $jsonStats.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $statistics.total -eq 3 -and
        $statistics.pending -eq 1 -and
        $statistics.completed -eq 2 -and
        $statistics.completionPercentage -eq 66.7
    ) 'stats JSON should report totals and rounded completion percentage'
    Assert-True (
        ($statistics.PSObject.Properties.Name -join ',') -eq
            'total,pending,completed,completionPercentage,createdByDate' -and
        ($statistics.createdByDate[0].PSObject.Properties.Name -join ',') -eq 'date,count'
    ) 'stats JSON should have stable property names'
    Assert-True (
        @($statistics.createdByDate).Count -eq 2 -and
        $statistics.createdByDate[0].date -eq '2025-01-02' -and
        $statistics.createdByDate[0].count -eq 1 -and
        $statistics.createdByDate[1].date -eq '2025-01-03' -and
        $statistics.createdByDate[1].count -eq 2
    ) 'stats JSON should group UTC dates in ascending order'
    Assert-True (-not $jsonStats.Output.Contains('TASKFORGE STATS')) 'stats JSON should not include the banner'

    $textStats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsDataFile)
    $banner = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile -Raw).TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
    Assert-True ($textStats.ExitCode -eq 0) 'text stats should succeed'
    Assert-True ($textStats.Output.StartsWith($banner)) 'text stats should display the banner first'
    Assert-True (
        $textStats.Output.Contains('Completion: 66.7%') -and
        $textStats.Output.IndexOf('2025-01-02: 1') -lt $textStats.Output.IndexOf('2025-01-03: 2')
    ) 'text stats should use invariant percentage formatting and ascending UTC dates'
    Assert-True (
        (Get-Content -LiteralPath $statsDataFile -Raw) -ceq $contentBeforeStats -and
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $statsDataFile).LastWriteTimeUtc -eq $writeTimeBeforeStats
    ) 'stats should not rewrite existing storage'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True (
        $help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and
        $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge') -and
        $help.Output.Contains('stats [--data-file PATH] [--json]')
    ) 'help should include stats'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    'PASS: fixture tests'
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
